The '''Red Pact''' was a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. The group was led by the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Graayl Nor]], and had three other members: a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], a [[Defel/Legends|Defel]], and a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]].<ref name="LoNH" />
